opening: I've been getting fevers every day.
It's been about a year; it had already been going on for 6 months when I first came to the clinic.
The fevers, tiredness and other general symptoms came on within the last 6 months; when I first came to the clinic about the hives, I had no general symptoms.
I have swollen glands in both armpits and both sides of my groin.
I've been treated with high doses of non-drowsy antihistamines for the rash.

opening.text: I've had chronic hives, or urticaria, for about a year; it had already been going on for 6 months when I first came to the clinic. I've been treated with high doses of non-drowsy antihistamines for the rash. The fevers, tiredness and other general symptoms came on within the last 6 months; when I first came to the clinic about the hives, I had no general symptoms. I've been getting fevers every day, I feel tired all over, and I've been having night sweats. I also have swollen glands in both armpits and both sides of my groin.
